About Me

Hi, I'm Jenny — a logistics and customer experience professional based in Melbourne. Originally from Vietnam, I've built a career around connecting people, carriers, and freight with care and precision.

I thrive in fast-paced environments where problem-solving and clear communication make all the difference. From allocating freight at Ofload to managing customer queries at SONIQ Logistics and supply chain work at Repertoire Culinaire, I bring a customer-first mindset to everything I do.

I'm also a Swinburne Emerging Leader Certificate holder, which reflects my drive to grow not just as a professional, but as a person who leads with empathy and purpose.
